facts.fact: Bankable reports that Switch Mosolo is the national payment switch developed under the Central Bank of Congo's oversight, with FINCA the first microfinance institution to join a pilot connecting through the Mosolo card.

systems.tiers: banks, microfinance institutions, e-money institutions, fintechs

COD.note: No consumer-protection rule or complaints body stated; the digital pricing pact is only a proposal.
No government payment to people stated.
No survey share of adults stated.
The switch is described as intended to connect providers and only a pilot connection is reported, so no interoperability or national switch in service is recorded.
No tax or fee payment stated.
